addressReference.description: An existing address endpoint. It never creates a property identity.

independentPropertyReference.description: An already established property endpoint, or null. System must not derive it from the address or provider response.

artifactFileReferencesBySha256.description: Maps each verified raw artifact digest to an existing file endpoint.

requirements: contextJson is canonical JSON and identical for the paired provider results
inputJson is the canonical provider JobRequest payload without credentials
primaryRawArtifactUri and primaryRawArtifactSha256 copy the selected ResultManifest file pointer exactly
outcome and failureCode copy transport outcomes without sale classification
sourceUri and sha256 copy the immutable file pointer exactly
bodyText is the exact UTF-8 decoded body and sha256 remains the digest of the original bytes
no provider field is parsed or normalized during packaging
artifactOrdinal is the zero-based ResultManifest file order
Google and RentCast acquisition rows use the same requestId
RentCast inputJson contains the exact normalized_address.one_line submitted to Connect
Google is identity evidence only and RentCast remains supporting partial listing evidence

prohibited: provider status classification in System or Connect
price parsing in System or Connect
property identity derived from an address
